notes:
Nori now reviews, tracks and builds on Gitea, Forgejo, Bitbucket Cloud and Azure DevOps, stacks your branches, and sends system notifications.

### Added

- In Reviews, change an open request's target branch from its header: click the target and pick another branch. The diff and commits follow. GitHub and GitLab never move its source branch.
- Without Pro, a pull request opened from Nori, or the end of a Pro trial, shows one closable line about Pro under the window bar: at most three times, a month apart, and the trial's end once.
- Stack branches as you create them or afterwards, from a branch's menu or by drag and drop. *Restack* replays those above when one changes, *Push stack* pushes them together, and Undo puts them back.
- With Pro, *Push & PR* on a stacked branch opens its pull request on the branch below. In Reviews, a request's Overview shows its stack; *Retarget onto main* follows a merge, *Stack on…* stacks a request.
- A fetch, pull or push refused by an SSH host Nori never connected to offers *Trust Host…*: compare its key fingerprints, then *Trust and Retry* adds it to `known_hosts` and runs the action again. No terminal needed.
- Reviews, Issues and *Push & PR* work with Gitea and Forgejo, Codeberg included: paste an access token in Settings ▸ Connections and Nori finds which forge the server runs.
- Reviews and *Push & PR* work with Bitbucket Cloud: paste an Atlassian API token in Settings ▸ Connections.
- Reviews, Issues and *Push & PR* work with Azure DevOps: name your organization and paste a personal access token in Settings ▸ Connections. Issues are Azure Boards work items; Pipelines shows the builds.
- Fetch, pull and push reach a Gitea, Forgejo, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps remote over HTTPS with the token pasted in Settings ▸ Connections, with no credential helper to set up.
- Without Pro, the Reviews and Issues previews show a Gitea, Forgejo or Bitbucket repository's own pull requests or issues too, read once with the token pasted in Settings ▸ Connections.
- System notifications while Nori is in the background: a Git action done, new commits to pull, a commit message ready, and with Pro a review asked of you, your checks or an issue assigned. Settings ▸ Notifications.
- With Pro, a notification when someone comments on a pull or merge request you opened or review, showing how the comment starts, and when someone approves yours. On GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo and Bitbucket.
- Reorder the sidebar's sections (branches, tags, stashes, worktrees…) by dragging a header, or with *Move Section Up* and *Down*. The order is the same in every repository; *Reset Section Order* restores it.

### Changed

- The Pro trial starts in one click: type your email, accept the terms, and Pro unlocks at once. Confirm your email from the link we send within 3 days to keep it.
- Without Pro, the Reviews and Issues previews show your repository's own open pull requests or issues, read once with the GitHub or GitLab CLI you are signed in to.

### Fixed

- In Reviews, the *Viewed* checkbox now works on GitLab merge requests. GitLab's API keeps no viewed state, so Nori remembers it on this computer, and a file that changes after you tick it asks for review again.
